ai: optional offline experiment after pilot; not enabled or required

original_baseline: pinned Emerald source PCM; hardware engine rendering not yet certified

public_payloads: tools, source identities, hashes, metadata and tests only
runtime_gates: Android cook, focus callback attachment, latency and memory
